description: Three pages of the cbbackupmgr module disagree about who may run the tool and under which edition, and none cross-references the others. cbbackupmgr.md states flatly 'cbbackupmgr is a Couchbase Enterprise Edition tool'. enterprise-backup-restore.md contradicts the edition claim directly ('available for both... Enterprise... and... Community Edition') and adds a role claim of its own ('Only Full Administrators can use cbbackupmgr'). cbbackupmgr-backup.md and cbbackupmgr-restore.md's own RBAC sections contradict the role claim: bucket-level backup/restore needs only the data_backup role, and cluster-level metadata needs service-specific admin roles (analytics_admin, eventing_admin, fts_admin) - never Full Admin specifically. A reader could combine any two of the three pages and reach a different, confident, wrong answer.
